Payload.$Comment: Mob scaling is switched off entirely in this instance. 'Where' says which worlds the rule covers, in the same vocabulary every other world-targeting file uses. The contains pattern is deliberate: a live instance world is named instance-<Name>-<uuid>, so the token sits mid-name and only a *Token* form reaches it. If your instance authors a GameplayConfig key, add "GameplayConfig": ["YourKey"] beside the pattern - that axis outranks every name pattern and never changes when the instance is rebuilt. PlayerScalingStartRingBlocks is pinned to 0 so that an owner who flips Enabled back on gets the player/group delta from the first block, instead of the global newcomer ring around world spawn suppressing it.
